entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hello, Steve. I need to make a return for a cycling jersey I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Got it, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the jersey was delivered 83 days ago. That's within our 10 days policy, so no problem, we can get this processed for you right away.
Oh, that's great! I wasn't sure if it had been too long. Thank you.

Absolutely. I've just started the process and I'm emailing the prepaid return label to you as we speak. Also, I see here you're a VIP member with us, so I've waived the standard restocking fee and added a 10% credit to your account for your next order.
Wow, that's fantastic! I really appreciate that, Steve. You've made this very easy.
It's my pleasure. Just print that return label, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
